subaccounts.intro: Use subaccounts to give each project its own SOCKS5 credentials and usage limit for dynamic residential proxies.
subaccounts.usernameHint: Use a SOCKS5 username such as {account}.shop01. Append -sid- followed by a session ID to select a session. Each static residential IP has its own credentials.
subaccounts.quotaHint: Enabled and disabled accounts both count.
subaccounts.quotaFull: All {quota} subaccount slots are used. Enabled and disabled accounts both count.
subaccounts.activeHint: Disabled accounts cannot start new connections.
subaccounts.usageHint: Across all subaccounts. 1 GB = 1 billion bytes.
subaccounts.name: Subaccount name
subaccounts.remarkPlaceholder: Describe how this account is used
subaccounts.disableImpact: Disabling this account blocks new connections. Existing connections stay open and usage continues to be counted. The account still uses a slot.
subaccounts.enableImpact: New connections still need sufficient tenant balance and available usage. Existing connections stay open.
subaccounts.passwordImpact: New connections use the new password. Existing connections stay open.
subaccounts.limitImpact: At the limit, new connections are blocked and existing usage continues to be counted.
subaccounts.limitEditHint: You can raise or remove the limit. Usage so far is {used} GB.
subaccounts.nameRule: Use 4–8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter. The name is fixed after creation.
subaccounts.passwordRule: Use 6–12 ASCII letters and digits, with at least one of each.
subaccounts.remarkRule: The note can be up to 512 bytes.
subaccounts.limitRule: Enter a valid number of GB with up to 9 decimal places.
subaccounts.belowUsage: The limit must be at least the current usage.
subaccounts.lowerLimit: You can raise or remove the current limit.
subaccounts.revealToCopy: Show the password first, then click Copy.
subaccounts.copyFailed: Copy failed. Check your browser’s clipboard permissions.

errors.INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_NAME: Use 4–8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter. The name is fixed after creation.
errors.SUBACCOUNT_NAME_EXISTS: This subaccount name is already in use.
errors.INVALID_PROXY_PASSWORD: Use 6–12 ASCII letters and digits, with at least one of each.
errors.INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_REMARK: The note can be up to 512 bytes.
errors.INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_LIMIT: You can raise or remove the current limit.
errors.SUBACCOUNT_LIMIT_BELOW_USAGE: The limit must be at least the current usage.

dynamicSetup.heading: SOCKS5 credentials
dynamicSetup.emptyHint: Create or enable a proxy subaccount to connect.
dynamicSetup.sidHelp: Connections using the same subaccount and session ID try to reuse the same exit. The exit IP may change on reconnect.
dynamicSetup.copyFailed: Copy failed. Check the browser clipboard permissions.
dynamicSetup.balanceHint: Traffic does not expire. A positive traffic balance is required for new connections.

dynamicGuide.heading: Connect to dynamic residential proxies over SOCKS5
dynamicGuide.region: Proxy products are unavailable from networks in mainland China.

purchase.title: Buy traffic
purchase.body: Buy a traffic package from Pricing. Traffic does not expire and is shared among the tenant’s subaccounts.

account.title: Create a subaccount
account.body: Create and enable an account in Proxy Subaccounts. Each subaccount can have its own usage limit.

credentials.title: Get connection details
credentials.body: Select an enabled subaccount in Proxy Setup and copy its gateway host, port, username, and password. The default SOCKS5 username uses this format.

session.title: Choose a session
session.body: For the default session, use the base username. To specify a session, append the suffix below. The session ID must contain 1–32 lowercase letters or digits.

connect.title: Configure and test the client
connect.body: Choose SOCKS5 in your client and enter the connection details. Use socks5h where supported to resolve the destination hostname through the proxy. You can also copy the curl command from Proxy Setup to check the exit IP.

usage.title: Check your usage
usage.body: Traffic is deducted by metered bytes. One GB is 1,000,000,000 bytes.

authentication.title: Why did authentication fail?
authentication.body: Check that the subaccount is enabled, the username includes the primary account prefix, and the password is current. If you specified a session, check the sid format.

quota.title: Why can’t I connect with valid credentials?
quota.body: Check the gateway host, port, and SOCKS5 settings. The tenant must have a positive traffic balance, and the subaccount must be below its usage limit if one is set.

rotation.title: Can the exit IP change within a session?
rotation.body: A session on the same subaccount tries to reuse the same exit. The upstream provider determines session duration and exit assignment. The exit IP can change on reconnect.
